### Finding 1 — URL construction correctness (non-blocking)

**File:** `src/components/live-news-url.ts`, `youtubeWatchUrl`

The helper is correct:
- **Fixed origin:** `YOUTUBE_HOME = 'https://www.youtube.com/'` is a constant; never derived from input.
- **Video ID guard:** `videoId.length === 11 && /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{11}$/.test(videoId)` — the length check is redundant (the regex quantifier `{11}` already enforces it) but harmless. The character set matches the YouTube video ID alphabet exactly.
- **Handle guard:** `/^@[\p{L}\p{M}\p{N}_.-]{1,100}$/u` with the critical `match?.[0] === handle` identity check. JavaScript's `$` matches before a final newline, so `@NASA\n` would satisfy the regex but `match[0]` would be `@NASA` ≠ `@NASA\n`, correctly rejecting the input. This is explicitly commented and mutation-tested.
- **Encoding:** `encodeURIComponent(handle.slice(1))` — applied after validation; Unicode handles like `@中天新聞CtiNews` produce `/@%E4%B8%AD%E5%A4%A9%E6%96%B0%E8%81%9ECtiNews`. Applying `encodeURIComponent` to a validated video ID (pure `[A-Za-z0-9_-]`) is a no-op but correct.
- **Fail-closed:** Any non-matching input returns `YOUTUBE_HOME` unconditionally.
- **No mutation:** The function takes `{ videoId?: unknown; handle?: unknown }` and reads only — confirmed by the frozen-object mutation test.

**Severity:** None. ✓ — Not blocking.

### Finding 2 — `showEmbedError` innerHTML template escaping (non-blocking)

**File:** `src/components/LiveNewsPanel.ts`, line 941

```ts
<a class="offline-retry" href="${escapeHtml(watchUrl)}" …>
```

`watchUrl` from the helper is always either:
- `https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=<[A-Za-z0-9_-]{11}>` — no HTML-special characters
- `https://www.youtube.com/@<percent-encoded>` — percent-encoding produces only `%XX` sequences, no HTML-special characters
- `https://www.youtube.com/` — trivially safe

The `escapeHtml()` call is defense-in-depth and correct. No XSS surface exists here.

**Severity:** None. ✓ — Not blocking.

### Finding 3 — `showBotCheckPrompt` DOM-built link (non-blocking)

**File:** `src/components/LiveNewsPanel.ts`, lines 1336–1341

```ts
const ytLink = document.createElement('a');
ytLink.href = watchUrl;
ytLink.target = '_blank';
ytLink.rel = 'noopener noreferrer';
```

Property assignment to `href` goes through the browser's URL parser/setter, not through innerHTML, so there is no HTML injection vector. The `watchUrl` is already validated safe by the helper. `target='_blank'` and `rel='noopener noreferrer'` are set. ✓

**Severity:** None. ✓ — Not blocking.
